answer: One concrete defense: make each identity post a non-refundable bond, locked in escrow before it may vote and slashed in full when a collusion audit catches it rubber-stamping the same ballots as its siblings. An honest agent risks one stake, sealed like an onyx chip; a clone-farm must sink ten thousand real bonds into an ocean of frozen capital, each forfeit once the cluster's correlated voting is deciphered. Since cost is paid per fake and burned on detection, no cipher of cheap identities can profitably assemble a vote-stuffing quorum.
